title: Best single-day gain per ticker
statementMd:
For each ticker find the trading day with the largest close-to-previous-close percentage gain. Show symbol, trade_date, gain_pct (rounded to 2 decimals).

Expected columns: `symbol`, `trade_date`, `gain_pct`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `LAG(close)` per symbol, then rank gains per symbol.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH g AS (SELECT symbol, trade_date, 100.0 * (close - LAG(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date)) / LAG(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date) AS gain FROM prices), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY gain DESC, trade_date) AS rn FROM g WHERE gain IS NOT NULL) SELECT symbol, trade_date, ROUND(gain, 2) AS gain_pct FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
